messages:
jun: Kicking off onboarding + canary plan for kepler-3b (INT8). Goal: hosted + Dedicated canary, then private if customers request. Posting a compact checklist and open questions. @maria take smoke QA runs? @khalid handle infra canary routing?

maria: got it, i'll own smoke and eval thresholds. can you paste the eval set and expected metrics?

jun: TL;DR checklist below. detailed notes after.

jun: CHECKLIST (high-level)
- model artifact: kepler-3b-int8 (v1.0-int8) ready in model-registry ✅
- baseline metrics: offline eval vs fp16 (few tasks) -> rouge delta, toxicity checks, instruction-following score
- perf targets: hosted p95 <= 160ms for 1-2k tokens; dedicated p95 <= 120ms
- cost target: token cost delta < 0.5x baseline quantized profile
- smoke-scenarios: convo, code, summarization, instruction-following
- rollout strategy: 5% hosted canary -> 25% -> 100% w/ automated rollback triggers
- dedicated: route 10% of reserved pool for canary, isolate tenant tags
- private: prepare packaging + network docs if enterprise asks
- rollback: immediate fallback to kepler-3b-fp16 or kepler-2.7b-int8 compatible variant

khalid: infra notes
- create canary pool: kepler3b-int8-canary (GPU: a100s quantized runtime)
- routing policy: prefer latency, then cost. add header route X-Model-Variant for testing
- autoscale: min=1, max=3 for canary, warmup kernel precompile step included
- add tracing: request_id + kvcache hit ratio metrics

maria: EVAL plan
- datasets: conv_eval_v2 (2k examples), code-synth-250, summarization-500, instruction-follow-1000
- pass criteria: task-level metric regressions <= 1.5% absolute or 5% relative (whichever stricter), instruction score >= baseline -0.02, safety flags no increase >0.1% absolute
- human spot-check: 50 samples per task, focus on hallucinations and instruction vibe
- automated diff harness: run eval-bot against prod fp16 and new int8; generate per-task delta table

eval-bot: running diffs now -> will post summary in this thread when complete (ETA ~25m)

jun: rollout controls + monitors
- anomaly detectors: response_length, token cost, p95 latency, error rate, top-k rejection rate
- perf guardrails: if p95 increases >20% OR error rate >0.5% absolute -> auto rollback
- quality guardrails: if any critical eval metric breaches pass criteria -> hold canary and notify @oncall
- gradual ramp config: 5% -> 15% -> 35% -> 100% (3h observation window each) for hosted
- dedicated ramp: 10% reserved, hold 4h per step

devon: warmup + cache
- load KV cache warmup: run 50 synthetic prompts to populate key prefixes, precompile attn kernels before traffic
- we should enable prefix caching for the first hour of canary traffic to reduce cold p95 spikes

jun: rollout playbook snippets (for runbook)
- Step 0: stop rollout if smoke tests fail or eval-bot posts FAIL
- Step 1: deploy canary into kepler3b-int8-canary pool (infra handles versions)
- Step 2: run smoke-suite (script: scripts/smoke_canary.sh) -> exit 0 passes
- Step 3: enable 5% routing, monitor for 3h; run automated diffs every 30m
- Step 4: if stable, proceed to next step; otherwise rollback to kepler-3b-fp16:stable

jun: CONFIG example (for routing + fallback)
```
route:
  default: kepler-3b-fp16:stable
  weighted:
    - variant: kepler-3b-int8:canary
      weight: 5
  fallback_policy:
    on_error: route to kepler-3b-fp16:stable
    on_latency_exceed: fallback to kepler-2.7b-int8:compatible
```

khalid: Also adding alerts -> #incidents and page @oncall if latency p95 > 200ms for >5min or error rate >1%

maria: eval-bot posted summary: conv_eval_v2: delta -0.8% (within threshold), code-synth: -2.1% (regression - investigate), summarization: +0.4%, instruction-follow: -0.015 (ok). Toxicity/filters: no change

maria: code-synth regression concentrated on long-context code generation. i'll run targeted ablation with different quant configs (INT8 vs int8+per-channel) and attach examples

jun: OK. hold canary ramp for now. @devon please run warmup + try per-channel quant config on a separate canary variant kepler3b-int8-pc

devon: started kepler3b-int8-pc canary build, warming kernels. will post sample diffs in ~40m

deploy-bot: deploy started: kepler3b-int8-canary -> pool kepler3b-int8-canary (build id: bld-20260320-71)

jun: thanks all. I'll update the runbook with the hold reasons and next steps. tagging this thread as the canonical canary intake for kepler-3b-int8.

maria: adding shortlist of examples that failed in code-synth -> will upload to docs/evals/kepler3b_int8/code_failures.md

khalid: infra will keep the canary pool isolated. ping here when you want to resume ramp.

deploy-bot: deploy complete: canary pool healthy 2/2 instances.

jun: closing note: we prefer conservative ramps for new quantized variants. always keep a compatible fp16 fallback and per-customer routing for dedicated/private.

(threads like this will be archived to the model onboarding binder)
